items.title: 23andMe Sells Gene-Testing Business to DNA Drug Maker Regeneron
items.title_zh: 23andMe 将基因检测业务出售给 DNA 药物公司 Regeneron
items.summary: 23andMe has sold its gene-testing business to Regeneron, described as a DNA drug maker, according to the Bloomberg report.

items.title: Side projects I've built since 2009
items.title_zh: 我从 2009 年以来做过的副业项目
items.summary: A developer lists side projects shipped, sold or shut down since 2009, ranging from modern.css to earlier WordPress experiments.

items.title: Is-even-ai – Check if a number is even using the power of AI
items.title_zh: is-even-ai：借助 AI 判断一个数字是否为偶数
items.summary: The npm package is-even-ai checks whether a number is even using AI, according to its listing on the npm registry.

items.title: An upgraded dev experience in Google AI Studio
items.title_zh: Google AI Studio 开发者体验升级
items.summary: Google's developer blog describes an upgraded AI Studio with Gemini 2.5 Pro, agentic tools and enhanced multimodal capabilities for developers building AI applications.

items.title: Roto: A Compiled Scripting Language for Rust
items.title_zh: Roto：面向 Rust 的编译型脚本语言
items.summary: The post introduces Roto, an embedded scripting language for Rust that aims to be simple, fast and reliable, and says the need arose from Rotonda, a BGP engine written in Rust.

items.title: Kotlin-Lsp: Kotlin Language Server and Plugin for Visual Studio Code
items.title_zh: Kotlin-Lsp：Kotlin 语言服务器与 VS Code 插件
items.summary: The Kotlin/kotlin-lsp repository provides a Kotlin language server together with a plugin for Visual Studio Code.

items.title: Caesar's Last Breath
items.title_zh: 凯撒的最后一口气
items.summary: A blog essay titled Caesar's Last Breath, published at charliesabino.com.

items.title: Writing A Job Runner (In Elixir) (Again) (10 years later)
items.title_zh: 用 Elixir 写一个任务运行器（十年后再度重写）
items.summary: A GitHub README for a 2025 tutorial on writing a job runner in Elixir, revisiting the same exercise a decade later.

items.title: Tariffs in American History
items.title_zh: 美国历史上的关税
items.summary: The essay traces US tariff policy back to Alexander Hamilton's first schedule as Treasury Secretary and notes that, because the Constitution forbids taxing state exports, American tariffs have always been levied on imports.

items.title: Dependency injection frameworks add confusion
items.title_zh: 依赖注入框架徒增困惑
items.summary: The article argues that dependency injection frameworks add confusion to software projects rather than making them easier to reason about.

items.title: Writing your own CUPS printer driver in 100 lines of Python (2018)
items.title_zh: 用 100 行 Python 编写自己的 CUPS 打印机驱动（2018）
items.summary: A 2018 post on the pretix engineering blog explains how to write a CUPS printer driver in roughly 100 lines of Python.

items.title: A lost decade chasing distributed architectures for data analytics?
items.title_zh: 数据分析是否在白追分布式架构上浪费了十年？
items.summary: DuckDB benchmarks its analytics database on a 2012 MacBook Pro to ask whether the industry lost a decade pursuing distributed architectures for data analytics.

items.title: China’s Xpeng to sell redesigned P7 sports sedan in Q3
items.title_zh: 小鹏将于第三季度开售改款 P7 运动轿车
items.summary: Xpeng Motors plans to sell a redesigned version of its P7 sports sedan in July or August, hoping to revive sales of the model.

items.title: Volkswagen-backed Gotion starts all-solid-state battery pilot production
items.title_zh: 大众参股的国轩高科启动全固态电池中试生产
items.summary: Gotion High-Tech, which is backed by Volkswagen, said on May 17 that it began pilot production of all-solid-state batteries and achieved self-reliance in the technology.

items.title: Xiaomi Redmi Turbo 4 Pro reaches one million units sold in under a month
items.title_zh: Redmi Turbo 4 Pro 上市不到一个月销量突破一百万台
items.summary: Xiaomi said on May 18 that sales of the Redmi Turbo 4 Pro passed one million units, less than a month after the device launched on April 24.

items.title: MediaTek’s first 2nm chip set to tape out in September
items.title_zh: 联发科首款 2nm 芯片将于 9 月流片
items.summary: At Computex Taipei 2025, MediaTek CEO Rick Tsai announced that the company's first 2nm chip is expected to tape out in September.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: Alibaba Cloud founder Jack Wang wants to take AI to space
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：阿里云创始人 Jack Wang 希望将 AI 带入太空
items.summary: At BEYOND Expo 2025, Alibaba Cloud founder Jack Wang outlined his ambition to take AI to space, contrasting it with an industry focused on parameter counts and GPU hoarding.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: Former OpenAI executive Zack Kass on rediscovering what it means to be human in the age of AI
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：前 OpenAI 高管 Zack Kass 谈 AI 时代如何重新理解人的意义
items.summary: Former OpenAI executive Zack Kass argues that AI's most profound impact over the coming decade may lie not in its technical capabilities but in how it compels people to reconsider what it means to be human.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: Interview with Zack Kass: AI’s ultimate challenge will be crisis of purpose
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025 专访 Zack Kass：AI 的终极挑战将是意义危机
items.summary: In an interview at BEYOND Expo 2025, Zack Kass discusses where artificial intelligence is leading society and argues that AI's ultimate challenge will be a crisis of purpose.

items.title: Xiaomi’s second EV model draws styling cues from Ferrari Purosangue
items.title_zh: 小米第二款电动车借鉴法拉利 Purosangue 设计风格
items.summary: Xiaomi's second EV model, the YU7, draws styling cues from the Ferrari Purosangue; its single-motor standard version is listed with 835 kilometers of range, compared with 590 kilometers for the Tesla Model Y.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: WaveSpeedAI boosts multimodal AI speeds, cuts costs
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：WaveSpeedAI 提升多模态 AI 速度、降低成本
items.summary: At BEYOND Expo 2025, TechNode reports on WaveSpeedAI's push to speed up multimodal AI and cut costs, set against a Chinese AI industry it describes as focused on performance optimization rather than brute-force scaling.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: Foreign brands in China must adapt to its unique social media ecosystem, expert says
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：专家称外国品牌必须适应中国独特的社交媒体生态
items.summary: At BEYOND Expo 2025, an expert said foreign brands must adapt to China's unique social media ecosystem, as Chinese brands expand overseas while foreign companies keep pursuing China's consumer base.

items.title: EdoStra/Marketing-for-Founders
items.title_zh: EdoStra/Marketing-for-Founders
items.summary: A collection of practical marketing resources for SaaS, app and startup founders looking to win their first 10, 100 and 1,000 users.

items.title: HuaYaoAI/FinGenius
items.title_zh: HuaYaoAI/FinGenius：Python 开源项目
items.summary: FinGenius is a Python-language repository published by HuaYaoAI on GitHub.

items.title: Gen-Verse/MMaDA
items.title_zh: Gen-Verse/MMaDA：开源多模态扩散语言模型
items.summary: MMaDA is an open-sourced multimodal large diffusion language model project that combines block diffusion, mixed chain-of-thought and unified reinforcement learning, implemented in Python.

items.title: Simon-He95/markstream-vue
items.title_zh: markstream-vue：面向 AI 应用的多框架流式 Markdown 渲染器
items.summary: A streaming Markdown renderer for AI applications supports Vue/Nuxt, React/Next.js, Octane, SolidJS, Svelte, Angular and Vue 2, with Mermaid, KaTeX, streaming code blocks, SSR and virtualized histories. The repository is tagged as Vue.

items.title: DreamTechAI/Direct3D-S2
items.title_zh: DreamTechAI/Direct3D-S2：基于空间稀疏注意力的超大规模 3D 生成
items.summary: Code for Direct3D-S2, a NeurIPS 2025 project that uses spatial sparse attention to make gigascale 3D generation easier, written in Python.

items.title: Gpower2/gMKVExtractGUI
items.title_zh: Gpower2/gMKVExtractGUI：mkvextract 的 C# 图形界面
items.summary: gMKVExtractGUI provides a C# graphical interface for mkvextract, the extraction utility that ships with MKVToolNix.

items.title: showlab/OmniConsistency
items.title_zh: showlab/OmniConsistency：风格无关一致性学习的官方实现
items.summary: The repository hosts the official code implementation for the paper "OmniConsistency: Learning Style-Agnostic Consistency from Paired Stylization Data."

items.title: trianglesplatting/triangle-splatting
items.title_zh: trianglesplatting/triangle-splatting（三角泼溅）
items.summary: triangle-splatting is a Python project on GitHub whose listing gives no description beyond its programming language.

items.title: huangkaoya/ts-redalert2
items.title_zh: huangkaoya/ts-redalert2 —— 红色警戒2 源代码
items.summary: A TypeScript repository that hosts source code for the game Red Alert 2, according to its GitHub description.

items.title: Enhancing Vision Transformer Explainability Using Artificial Astrocytes
items.title_zh: 利用人工星形胶质细胞增强视觉 Transformer 的可解释性
items.summary: The paper proposes ViTA, a training-free, neuroscience-inspired method that adds artificial astrocytes to a pretrained Vision Transformer, and reports statistically significant improvements in the alignment between Grad-CAM and Grad-CAM++ heatmaps and human perception on the ClickMe dataset.

items.title: Beyond Domain Randomization: Event-Inspired Perception for Visually Robust Adversarial Imitation from Videos
items.title_zh: 超越域随机化：受事件启发的视觉鲁棒对抗性视频模仿
items.summary: The paper converts ordinary RGB videos into sparse, event-based representations that encode temporal intensity gradients, aiming to make imitation learning invariant to appearance differences without domain randomization; it evaluates the method on the DeepMind Control Suite and Adroit manipulation tasks.

items.title: Augmenting Online RL with Offline Data is All You Need: A Unified Hybrid RL Algorithm Design and Analysis
items.title_zh: 用离线数据增强在线强化学习就够了：统一的混合 RL 算法设计与分析
items.summary: The paper presents a unified hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm and analysis showing that adding offline data to confidence-based online RL outperforms either approach alone on sub-optimality gap and regret. Experiments cover linear contextual bandits and Markov decision processes.

items.title: STree: Speculative Tree Decoding for Hybrid State-Space Models
items.title_zh: STree：面向混合状态空间模型的推测树解码
items.summary: The paper presents STree, described as the first scalable algorithm for tree-based speculative decoding in state-space models and hybrid SSM-Transformer architectures, with a hardware-aware implementation that beats vanilla SSM speculative decoding on three benchmarks.

items.title: From Compression to Expression: A Layerwise Analysis of In-Context Learning
items.title_zh: 从压缩到表达：上下文学习的逐层分析
items.summary: A statistical geometric analysis of in-context learning finds a Layerwise Compression-Expression pattern: early layers build compact task representations from demonstrations, while later layers express them together with the query to produce a prediction. The pattern holds across tasks and architectures, and a bias-variance decomposition links attention to reductions in both variance and bias as demonstrations increase.

items.title: Conformal Prediction for Uncertainty Estimation in Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
items.title_zh: 药物靶点相互作用预测中的共形预测不确定性估计
items.summary: The study compares three cluster-conditioned conformal prediction methods with marginal and group-conditioned alternatives for drug-target interaction prediction, finding on the KIBA dataset that nonconformity-based clustering yields the tightest intervals and most reliable subgroup coverage.

items.title: SETransformer: A Hybrid Attention-Based Architecture for Robust Human Activity Recognition
items.title_zh: SETransformer：用于稳健人体活动识别的混合注意力架构
items.summary: SETransformer is a hybrid architecture that combines Transformer temporal modeling with channel-wise squeeze-and-excitation attention and learnable temporal attention pooling for human activity recognition from raw triaxial accelerometer data. On the WISDM dataset it reaches 84.68% validation accuracy and an 84.64% macro F1 score, outperforming LSTM, GRU, BiLSTM and CNN baselines.

items.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
items.title_zh: 内存管理如何影响 LLM 智能体：经验遵循行为的实证研究
items.summary: An empirical study finds that LLM agents exhibit experience-following behavior, where inputs similar to retrieved memories yield similar outputs, and identifies error propagation and misaligned experience replay as risks.

items.title: Recent Deep Learning in Crowd Behaviour Analysis: A Brief Review
items.title_zh: 近期深度学习在人群行为分析中的应用：简要综述
items.summary: A review chapter surveys recent deep learning work on crowd behaviour analysis, focusing on prediction and recognition and covering both pure neural network models and methods that combine physics with deep learning.
